static_traits.name: 林若兰
static_traits.educational_background: 在一所小型社区学院就读的Student
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病史；without既往心理治疗史；not yet有类似问题经历
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度较好；语气偏消极，反复Self-doubt；能具体描述工作场景中的困扰与情绪

basic_info.main_problem: 我认为自己被调到医院的新科室是因为工作做得很差，这导致我出现Self-doubt和Anxiety。
basic_info.core_demands: These thoughts and feelings are affecting my confidence at work and overall happiness, so I decided to seek counseling.

special_situations.event: After being transferred to a new hospital department, the supervisor explained it was 'we need your experience', but the client believes this is an excuse
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果被调岗，一定是因为我表现not好；他人not会告诉我真实的负面评价
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeks comfort and reassurance from colleagues and supervisors, but inside continuously doubts their sincerity
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being perfunctory with me; the real reason is I did very poorly

special_situations.event: 在新科室面对not熟悉的新流程与任务
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能一次做对，就说明我not胜任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces interaction with colleagues, avoids proactively seeking help, chooses to hide after making mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am going to mess this up again, just like everything else

special_situations.event: 主管偶尔对工作表示感谢、同事给予Average性安慰
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 正面反馈not可靠，do not人只是好心安慰并not是真心认可
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 继续寻求外部保证，但快速negate正向反馈的价值
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这not是真心的，他们只是说说而已

special_situations.event: 在工作中面对新挑战或任务时感到高压和Anxiety
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only when I receive explicit affirmation from others do I have value; otherwise it means I am bad
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复向同事或主管寻求认可与确认
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果他们not肯定我，就说明我not行

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted; hopes her abilities will be genuinely affirmed at work
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate和被视为not胜任，担心他人隐藏真实负面评价
defense_goal: 通过寻求保证与保持谨慎来降低被negate的风险；避免暴露not足以维持安全感

object_relations.self_representation: not胜任、容易出错、需要他人认可的自己
object_relations.object_representation: 表面安慰但not真正理解、可能隐藏真实负面评价的他人（上级/同事）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When told 'the transfer is because your experience is needed' or invited in counseling to accept positive feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向于认为对方在敷衍或隐藏真实负面评价（移情：他人not真诚）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in a cautious, questioning tone, emphasizing 'this is just an excuse/politeness', avoiding deeply accepting positive information.

manifestations: 难以与新同事建立联系并主动求助
在工作中感到“without人真正理解我”的落差感
新岗位带来更高的职责与选择压力
对not确定结果的担忧与责任Anxiety

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: When needing help, restrains the help-seeking impulse and chooses to tough it out alone
After making mistakes, wants to hide and avoid direct contact with colleagues

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 反复Self-doubt，强调“I am not good enough / I will fail”
Hard to accept positive feedback, persistently judges oneself by negative standards

exception_events.target_problem: 在面对新任务或挑战的工作情境中，来访者通常会陷入Self-doubt与Anxiety，并认为自己表现很差，难以接纳正向反馈。
exception_events.unique_outcome: On several occasions after tasks ended, the supervisor thanked her for her efforts; that day, after making a mistake, she still did her best to correct it and complete the task, and received a positive response.
exception_events.reason: 线索：她在犯错后主动尝试修正问题（做法not同）；主管注意到她的努力并给出感谢（not同支持），因此出现了与以往Self-denialnot同的结果。

positive_force: Has transferable work experience (the transfer notice shows demand for her experience)
犯错后主动纠错、坚持完成任务
愿意尝试咨询并探索替代性解释
拥有几位可倾诉的朋友
negative_force: Dysfunctional thinking patterns such as overgeneralization, jumping to conclusions, personalization
过度依赖外部认可且negate正向反馈
与新同事连接与求助困难
Anxiety影响睡眠与学习专注，进一步削弱工作表现

target_behavior.behavior: 在工作场景中的强烈Self-doubt与Anxiety（伴随回避求助、negate正向反馈）
antecedent: After being transferred to a new department, negative interpretation of the transfer reason
面对not熟悉的新流程与任务
收到主管或同事的正向反馈/安慰
在高压环境中承担新职责
target_behavior.core_reason: 对自身能力的消极核心信念（“I am not good enough”）与认知歪曲（过度概括、读心术、个人化、negate正面），并对外部认可的高度依赖。
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在失败与负面评价的威胁、寻求安慰与外部确认以暂时缓解Anxiety。
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected；与同事关系建立与求助受限；Anxiety worsened并影响睡眠与学习专注。
